PLAINTIFF SONG YANG, ASSISTED BY COURT CERTIFIED MANDARIN INTERPERTER, VIVIAN CHOY IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT INGRID HASUN KONG IS PRESENT VIA UNAUTHORIZED ZOOM APPEARANCE.
